en: {fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you learn martial arts at the castle?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}They taught me the bare minimum, so I could protect myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I never dreamed it'd come in handy for being a hero, though.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope it serves you well in the coming fight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Hmhmm~. Just leave it to me. I'm not doing all this just to work up a sweat, y'know!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that all?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Don't worry about it. I'm used to that sort of thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm fine. Not at all. What about you, my dear angel? You're floating around like that...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Let me see... It's not so bad, since I get to discover good wine...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you. Yes, I'm resting properly. So there's no need to worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, the same as always.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}My, thank you. But there's no need to worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is it? I don't like walking around.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Are you half asleep? Then go wash your face and come back later.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...I'm not.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It has... Leaving a fine woman like me all alone... You're a hopeless angel, you know that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I don't pay it much mind... Next time I'll make a point of looking at the view.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really. After all, you're the only one who pops up like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}...What? You came all this way just for that? You're a strange one, my dear angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I don't dislike it. That sort of thing. Hehe, thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you. But you needn't fuss over me so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Do I really look that helpless...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you dance in all sorts of towns?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I do. Whenever the mood strikes, I suppose...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever go to faraway towns to dance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, I do... Sometimes I'm asked to, and sometimes I just feel like going...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It has... Have you been well?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}My, thank you. How sweet of you to say so.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}What are you saying? Don't worry about it. Not tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You're thinking of me? So you do have a kind side, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh, no. I don't mind it. Sometimes I drink the whole night through.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}You're far too serious...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you go out at night?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not tonight. I'm not in the mood. Keep me company another time, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You came all this way to tell me that? Thank you. But you needn't fuss over me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You're worried about me? So you do have a kind side, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So. Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I suppose. Though I don't eat much myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It's all right. Right now I don't mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, there are. I can't stand anything that doesn't taste good.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...... Now and then, I suppose... Oh, who cares about that...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Are you? Then why not hurry back and get something to eat?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you always eat alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hardly... You think people would leave a fine woman like me alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a place you go to often?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yes, there is. I'm a known face in quite a few places.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So. Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that all? Nothing else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Troubles...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Some things don't get any better no matter how much you think about them...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really. Though if you just stand there like that, you will be.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I'm not tired. But talking about this is tiring me out...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Do I? To me, you're the one who looks like you're having fun, my dear angel...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Oh? Having fun isn't something you learn from others. You find it on your own.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you drunk?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...I'm not drunk. You haven't got the wrong idea about me, have you, my dear angel...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'd love to see you dance.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Hehe... When the mood strikes, maybe...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is that all? Nothing else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What else is there?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I don't mind moving my body...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...Not really.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}A little longer... I've only just gotten in the mood for it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If you're curious, why not stay and watch? But not today.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No need to worry. This much is nothing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a trick to swinging a weapon?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, yes, there is. Just swinging it around won't get you anywhere.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you think I could do it too?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You? Hehe. You'd better not. You'll hurt yourself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I found {name:0180}! The way things look, if you don't go see them now, they might never come back.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}We've lost all trace of {name:0180}...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Angel! I found {name:0180}, who went missing!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Garf, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}His name is Yaruru Willing, and he's a twelve-year-old boy who helps his family get by making handicrafts.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}He's great with a boomerang, plenty good enough for a hero, but what's even more amazing is that he has a sacred beast with him!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}A sacred beast only ever serves angels, so just having one with him makes him a hero already! {fb:0880}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}In Tambour, in Kvaal, I found someone who'd make a perfect hero!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her name is Fiana Ecliya, and she's a swordswoman who works as a bounty hunter.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Her sense of justice, her skill with a sword... she seems just about perfect, but... for some reason, she's said to be really fussy about money.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Still, someone as strong as her would make just the kind of hero you were talking about, I think.
